hints: Evaluate the numerical value $g(f(2))$ by first finding $f(2)$, then substituting into $g(x)$.
Form the expression for $f(f(x))$ by substituting $f(x)$ into itself.
Set the two expressions equal and solve for $x$.
walkthrough:
Evaluate the right-hand side composite function value $g(f(2))$:
$$f(2) = 10 - 3(2) = 4$$
$$g(f(2)) = g(4) = \frac{10}{3 - 2(4)} = \frac{10}{-5} = -2$$

Find an algebraic expression for the composite function $f(f(x))$ on the left-hand side:
$$f(f(x)) = 10 - 3(10 - 3x) = 10 - 30 + 9x = 9x - 20$$

Equate $f(f(x))$ and $g(f(2))$ and solve the resulting linear equation for $x$:
$$9x - 20 = -2 \implies 9x = 18 \implies x = 2$$

ai_rubric.Functions: Finds $f(f(x)) = 9x - 20$ (B1). Evaluates $g(f(2)) = -2$ (B1). Solves linear equation to get $x = 2$ (B1).
